description: This file is a shell script that automates testing of git-p4 integration with Perforce, including setting up test servers, repositories, and verifying synchronization and cloning behaviors.

methods.name: create_restricted_group
methods.description: Creates a Perforce group named 'restricted' with limited maximum results and scan rows, and assigns user 'author' to it.

methods.name: p4_add_file
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce depot and submits it, used for setting up test repositories.
